understood_argument_ko: 이 글은 같은 광학장에서 평균 광량과 광자 계수 분포를 학습 특징으로 구성했을 때의 함수 복원 차이를 설명한다. 이어 특징을 얻는 측정시간과 검출 응답을 살피고, 공간 확산·조건부 상관·고전 표본화의 서로 다른 조건을 구분해 후속 센서 설계에서 비교할 내용을 제안한다.

contextual_findings.before: Abstract attraction of fast optical propagation, repeated cautions and a generic development-value statement
contextual_findings.after: Actual detector records lead to feature construction, acquisition cost and specific count-range/acquisition-time comparisons
contextual_findings.assessment: The opening now identifies an operation a reader can follow. The conclusion advances a concrete design question instead of repeating an abstract evaluation.

contextual_findings.before: Figurative reading language in title, paragraph transitions and readout terminology
contextual_findings.after: Performance and acquisition time in the title; measurement, counting, sampling and a defined output stage in the explanation
contextual_findings.assessment: The requested translationese correction is applied to the meaning and paragraph flow rather than a fixed synonym replacement.

Remaining negative distinctions identify actual experimental or mathematical conditions: absorption versus reusable-state preparation, feature variance versus prediction evaluation, detector range, and exact probability evaluation versus sampling. Removing them uniformly would change the argument. No mandatory reversal or contrast template was imposed.
The first/second/third structure follows three existing claims and their different evidence. It is useful within this article rather than an invented common pattern for all reviews.

The languages preserve the same main argument, operational definitions, comparative strength, limitations, equations, author-reported table and editorial proposals. Sentence boundaries are adapted naturally. Extra English history detail makes the English editing role explicit without presenting it as independent review of its own revision.

The revised titles correspond in subject and focus. The bilingual summaries identify the damped-sinusoid comparison and approximately 32-minute complete-dataset acquisition condition; they do not claim general superiority over classical learning or a newly measured speedup.

minor_finding_resolved.reason: The original English wording could suggest that the baseline itself improved.

limits: This is a manuscript prose and literal-preservation review, not a new assessment of the primary research or a reproduction of scientific values.
Formal references and citations were inspected for manuscript correspondence and first-use order. Primary-source/APS bibliographic verification is performed separately by the scientific reviewer.
No candidate build, whole-payload inventory, render, browser interaction, PDF creation/download, deployment, CI, recovery, reader synchronization or human-reader test was performed in this subtask.
